answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Registered plough carpenter beam file with plough carpenters confirmation is the check, and it reads 3-year training, 242 supervised buildings, craft exam, annual re-assessment. One agent, one proof, 107 POA. 729 agents, 729 proofs, 78003 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. The trellis belongs to a clerk who never met the applicant, the wander belongs to a budget the applicant never sees, and the ocean belongs to the public record. One real credential beats a hundred printed ones, every epoch.
